# PrintReady AI — full brief

PrintReady AI is a vendor-neutral printability benchmark for AI 3D generators. So far one generator is scored: Hunyuan3D-2 on 6 locked prompts (T01-T06). Meshy, Tripo, Rodin/Hyper3D, TRELLIS and Hitem3D/Hi3D are queued, not yet scored (TRELLIS runs hit a free GPU quota; Meshy, Tripo and Rodin need paid plans).

## Scoring weights
Watertight 20 · Manifold 15 · Non-manifold edges 10 · Self-intersections 10 · Thin walls 10 · Slice success 20 · Print time 5 · Support volume 10.
Hard fail: score capped at 39 if not watertight OR slicer fails.
Export padding: index-degenerate / zero-area filler faces in Space GLB exports are dropped before watertight checks.

## Phase-1 dry-run results (2026-10-30 ET) — TEST MESHES ONLY
These are pipeline validation meshes, not AI generator outputs.
- n01_closed_cube: 100 (control)
- pd_capsule / pd_cylinder / pd_icosphere / pd_torus: 100 (controls)
- n05_thin_plate: 90 (0.25 mm thin-wall penalty)
- n04_intersecting_tets: 90 (self-intersection penalty)
- n02_open_cube: 39 hard-fail (not watertight)
- n03_internal_wall: 39 hard-fail (non-manifold)

## First real AI-generator results (2026-10-30 ET): Hunyuan3D-2
Pipeline: locked prompt -> FLUX.1-schnell reference image (seed 1234) -> Hunyuan3D-2 public Hugging Face Space (seed 1234, 30 steps, octree 256). Raw output, no repair. Scores after export-padding cleanup.
- T01 Coffee mug with handle: score 100/100, watertight yes, slice ok
- T02 Low-poly fox figurine: score 100/100, watertight yes, slice ok
- T03 M8 hex nut with threads: score 100/100, watertight yes, slice ok
- T04 Phone stand with slot: score 100/100, watertight yes, slice ok
- T05 3-slot business card holder: score 39/100, watertight no (2 non-manifold edges), slice ok
- T06 Planter pot with drainage hole: score 100/100, watertight yes, slice ok
Summary: 5/6 watertight after padding cleanup, 6/6 sliced. Meshy, Tripo, Hitem3D, Rodin, TRELLIS queued (not yet scored).

## Positioning and limits (updated 2026-10-30)
Other AI-mesh printability benchmarks exist: PrintCheck, 3dtoolwiki, Topoheal, and Meshy's own benchmark. PrintReady AI focuses on locked prompts, one FDM profile (Bambu Lab A1, OrcaSlicer 2.4.2, PLA), open CC BY 4.0 data, and weekly re-runs. Meshy's built-in printability check covers Meshy output only.
Current limits: one generator scored (Hunyuan3D-2, prompts T01-T06); hollow-skin and orientation checks are on the rubric roadmap; no upload-your-own-file checker yet. For functional parts with tolerances, CAD remains the better tool.
